content.title: Charlotte Hornets Tickets
content.text: The Charlotte Hornets are working hard to turn their franchise around and have added some All-Star caliber players to the roster of this talented young team, who are beginning to find their feet. The franchise is focused on the future and the mentoring needed to build a cohesive, valuable team. It's not a rebuild, but a transformation they’re looking for. Hornets fans are ready to see the new core roster lead them on to championship contention in the seasons ahead. The Charlotte Hornets franchise was founded in 1988 as an NBA expansion team. The Hornets were moved to New Orleans in 2002, and a later deal with the NBA saw a new team called the Charlotte Bobcats start competing in 2004. The team was rebranded as the Charlotte Hornets for the 2014 season and reclaimed the history of the original Charlotte Hornets. The Hornets franchise have won no Division titles to date. They’ve made it to the Eastern Conference Semifinals 4 times but have yet to secure a Conference title or appear in an NBA Finals game. Most fans point to the Miami Heat as the Hornets biggest rivals. Going to a Charlotte Hornets home game at Spectrum Center is a lot of fun. North Carolinians love basketball at all levels and the Spectrum Center is a friendly, enjoyable place to catch an NBA game. Leave some time to check out the beautiful galleries and public art displays before the tip-off. Sound like something you want to experience live?
